'''Adar 7 (April 19)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - [[Perrin Aybara]] and his party arrive in [[Remen]], he meets [[Faile Bashere]] and rescues [[Gaul]] and kills some [[Whitecloak]]s. The party leaves Remen on the ''[[Snow Goose]]'' which is bound for [[Illian]]. Perrin has a wolf dream and speaks with [[Hopper]]. [[Rand al'Thor]] camps in the [[Murandy|Murandian]] hills and kills a company of [[Darkfriends]].
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Luan Norwelyn]] and the other undecided nobles enter [[Caemlyn]] and speak with [[Elayne Trakand]]. All of them except [[Ellorien Traemane]] eventually pledge their support to Elayne, giving her the [[Lion Throne]].
